_comment: The games of the C4b combination sweep (docs/projects/sega-track-c4b.md section 2). Put the ROMs in one folder (names below; no ROM is in the repo) and set BN_SWEEP_ROMS to it: Workshop --bridge-sweep --manifest Workshop\Sega\bridge-sweep-games.json --out <dir> --frames 400 --jobs 2 --menus | --swaps --ids smb1,smw,sml,zeldadx,alexkidd,sonic-gg,sonic1 [--frames 600 for sml] | --cross --ids smb1,smw,sml,alexkidd,sonic-gg,sonic1. The input scripts keep every picture moving in the second half of the run, which is where a swapped core is judged: the Game Boy game needs three Start presses and Right from frame 260, and 600 frames (a still title or a still level makes every swap cell 'static': nothing to judge).
